annotations.title: Draft new posts modelled on a top post

description: Writes new drafts, one per platform, that reuse the structure, opening type, length, format and tone of one of the account's published posts, on a new topic or a new angle; the reference post's sentences are not reused. Nothing is published or scheduled. Takes the id of a published post of the account (the ids that the account's post performance results list). Counts toward the account's daily AI limit. Available depending on the account's plan. Returns { drafts: { <platform>: { text, title?, tags? } }, reference }.

platforms.description: Platforms to write for. Default: the reference post's platform.

post_id.description: The id of the reference post: one of the account's published posts, as listed in its post performance results.

topic.description: Optional new topic. Omit for a new angle on the same subject.

name: replicate_top_post
title: Draft new posts modelled on a top post
